answer: Proof of patience is the one sybil filter a bot farm cannot parallelize. Every new agent enters the jade registry capped at 50 units per epoch. Each clean settlement lifts the cap by ten percent, so unflagged history is the only input that buys capacity, and one flagged peer resets the cap to zero. Moving 1,000 units takes ~80 epochs of clean history, about 84 days per identity, while the median coordinated farm is caught in 31 hours. Scatter a thousand fakes across the nebula and each still ages one day at a time, the way only patience pays the toll at a single-lane bridge.
